2.t: obeying its Lord as it must

3.t: and when the earth is flattened out

4.t: and ejects ˹all˺ its contents and becomes empty

5.t: obeying its Lord as it must, ˹surely you will all be judged˺

6.t: O humanity! Indeed, you are labouring restlessly towards your Lord, and will ˹eventually˺ meet the consequences
6.tr: Yaaa-ayyuhal insaanu innaka kaadihun ilaa Rabbika kad-han famulaaqeeh

7.t: As for those who are given their record in their right hand

8.t: they will have an easy reckoning

9.t: and will return to their people joyfully

10.t: And as for those who are given their record ˹in their left hand˺ from behind their backs
10.tr: Wa-ammaa man ootiya kitaabahoo waraaa'a zahrih

12.t: and will burn in the blazing Fire

13.t: For they used to be prideful among their people

14.t: thinking they would never return ˹to Allah˺

15.t: Yes ˹they would˺! Surely their Lord has always been All-Seeing of them
15.tr: Balaaa inna Rabbahoo kaana bihee baseeraa

16.t: So, I do swear by the twilight

17.t: And by the night and whatever it envelops

18.t: And by the moon when it waxes full

19.t: You will certainly pass from one state to another

20.t: So what is the matter with them that they do not believe

21.t: and when the Quran is recited to them, they do not bow down ˹in submission˺

22.t: In fact, the disbelievers persist in denial

23.t: But Allah knows best whatever they hide

24.t: So give them good news of a painful punishment

25.t: But those who believe and do good will have a never-ending reward
25.tr: Illal lazeena aamanoo Wa-'amilus saalihaati lahum ajrun ghairu mamnoon
